about: Stated as a conjecture about structure and never about arithmetic: amplitudes with phase and no origin, no signed ceiling, no resolution and no epoch band are what is left of a cell when those four fields are dropped.

What can be measured is measured here. Four claims in phase against an environment spread over the period keep the coherence their share of the whole leaves them: one, then the signal over the total, down to three hundredths at a hundred and twenty-eight.
And six origins around one value are six objects read finely and one read coarsely, so how many things there are is a reading and not a fact about the things.

cases.name: four in phase, an environment, and six origins

title: Amplitudes without an origin
brief: what is left of a cell when who, ceiling, resolution and band are dropped
